DECLARE

 nLots NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 nullchk;

 -- IM:8423

 else

 end if; 
 ----
 
 SELECT count(*)
 INTO temp_count
 FROM valid_catalogs
 WHERE catalog_number = :valid_lots.catalog_number
 ---AND bag_type = :ctrl_block_1.bag_code
 AND chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);

 -- check for duplicate

 select nvl(count(*),0) into nLots from valid_lots where lot_number=:valid_lots.lot_number and

 Elsif :system.record_status ='CHANGED' then

 catalog_number=:valid_lots.catalog_number and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and
 :valid_lots.catalog_number <> :global.original_catalog;
 End If;
 
 --MLT-3527
 If nLots > 0 then 
 show_error('5238');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 null;
 End if;
 
 
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 szString varchar2(50);
 pos_count number:=0;
 k number:=0;
 cmc_code varchar2(50);
 comma_location number:=0;

procedure mark_rec (pl_CMC_CODE in varchar2) is
Begin
 go_block('CMC_BLOCK');
 first_record;
 Loop
 If pl_cmc_code=:cmc_block.code then
 :CMC_BLOCK.select_box:='Y';
 End if;
 
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 Else
 next_record;
 End if;
 End loop;
End mark_rec;

BEGIN


If :SP_FLAG is not null then
 :GLOBAL.CURRENT_CMC_FLAG:=:sp_flag;
End If;
show_view('CMC_PAGE');
go_block('CMC_BLOCK');
clear_block;
execute_query;
 
 

szString :=:sp_flag; --:GLOBAL.CURRENT_CMC_FLAG;
--message(szString);pause;

k:=1;
For i in 1.. Length (szString) loop
 pos_count:=pos_count+1;
 comma_location:=instr(szString,',',1,pos_count);
 If comma_location=0 then
 cmc_code:=substr(szString,k);
 --message('K='||to_char(k)||' A='||cmc_code);pause;
 mark_rec(cmc_code);
 exit;
 Else 
 cmc_code:=substr(szString,k,comma_location-k);
 --message('K='||to_char(k)||'com code='||cmc_code||' comma_location='||to_char(comma_location));pause;
 mark_rec(cmc_code);
 k:=comma_location+1;
 End If;
End Loop;
END;

:sp_flag:= :GLOBAL.CMC_FLAG;
